usage: The phrase '一分鐘' is used to specify a duration of time equal to sixty seconds.
'一分鐘' can function as a time measurement within sentences to indicate how long something takes or how much time has passed.
It can be used with verbs like '等' (to wait) or '走' (to leave) to indicate the time involved in an action.
You can combine '一分鐘' with other time expressions to make comparisons or instructions.
In informal speech, '一分鐘' expresses short durations and is often used for quick instructions or measurements.
